description: Turns gates and triggers from up to four sources into one clean reset trigger, ignoring further arrivals for a set time so that several sources cannot reset a sequencer twice over

params.text: Sets how long after a trigger further arrivals are ignored, 0ms to 1000ms
Sets how long the output trigger lasts, 1ms to 1000ms

inputs.text: One of the four sources; a rise past 2V calls for a reset trigger

outputs.text: A trigger of the set length whenever a reset is asked for and the merge window has passed

notes: the merge window is held to at least the trigger length, so it can never be shorter than the trigger it is meant to cover
a further arrival while a trigger is already going out does not lengthen it, and no second trigger follows
the output's channel count is the largest of the four inputs, and an input with one channel triggers every output channel
the lamps beside the jacks turn blue when that jack is carrying more than one channel
